categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in software technology services, data processing services, electronic information supply, software wholesale and retail, electronic materials wholesale and retail, telecommunications equipment wholesale and retail, and international trade. Its core products include the Mobility Intelligence™ platform and the CovMo™ mobile network optimization and positioning platform, serving telecom operators and digital advertising clients globally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary AI algorithms, machine learning, big data analytics, and patented telecom data analysis technologies. It develops software platforms for mobile network optimization and geo-location, integrating chaos theory and deep learning for enhanced positioning accuracy. The CovMo™ platform supports 5G and O-RAN architectures, while the Mobility Intelligence™ platform utilizes anonymized telecom data for real-time user behavior analysis and programmatic advertising.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are global telecommunications operators across more than twenty countries, including major markets in Asia, Africa, Europe, and the Americas. The company also serves advertisers, e-commerce platforms, and advertising agencies by providing telecom data-driven digital advertising solutions. Governments have also utilized its technology for pandemic control and smart city applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant revenue contributions from Asia, Africa, Europe, Oceania, and the Americas. It has established partnerships and sales networks in over twenty countries worldwide, with strategic focus on high-growth markets such as India, North America, and Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions primarily as an upstream software technology provider within the telecommunications industry, supplying advanced data analytics and optimization platforms directly to telecom operators. It fills a niche in the telecom value chain by providing software solutions that complement hardware from equipment manufacturers and support midstream telecom operators and downstream advertising clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing AI product lines, integrating large language models (LLM), and developing deep packet inspection (DPI) capabilities. The company focuses on improving customer experience, expanding market share, and diversifying value-added services. R&D efforts emphasize 5G and future 6G network optimization, digital twin technology, network slicing, and AI-driven advertising solutions, with significant investment in innovation and collaboration with research institutes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through software product sales and licensing to telecom operators, supplemented by service contracts for network optimization and data analytics. Additional income streams include digital advertising platform services that enable real-time bidding and targeted marketing, leveraging telecom data monetization. The company also benefits from government and institutional contracts for public health and smart city applications.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global pioneer and market leader in telecom big data analytics and mobile network optimization software, with few direct competitors internationally, mainly three US-listed companies focused on hardware. Its pure software, neutral third-party approach and extensive patent portfolio provide a competitive edge. In digital advertising, it competes against major internet giants like Alphabet, Meta, and Amazon but leverages unique telecom data advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$393.8 million and net profit after tax of NT$119.2 million, with a gross margin of 84% and a net profit margin of 30%. It has shown steady revenue growth and increased R&D investment, which accounted for 32% of revenue in 2024. The company’s equity and capital structure have strengthened following successful capital raises and stock listings, supporting ongoing expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers highly accurate, user-centric mobile network optimization and geo-location solutions based on proprietary AI and machine learning technologies, enabling telecom operators to improve network quality and ROI. Its platforms uniquely combine telecom big data with advanced analytics to provide actionable insights for network management and digital advertising, ensuring privacy compliance. The integration of AI and LLM further differentiates its products by enhancing automation, precision, and customer experience.
